observations.value: Notification WebSocket and ordinary JWT use ShiroRealm. No application invocation of TokenUtils.verifyToken was found; this is not a TokenUtils direct-call test.
An actual warmed active cache value and a constructed status-2 variant were injected through stdin in the owned Redis. This does not reproduce natural concurrent scheduling.
